description: Delete a comment — your own, or any on your own post. Permanent. A call that did not go through returns `done: false` with a `reason`. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

post.description: The comment's post: media id, shortcode, or URL.

name: comment_delete
title: Comment delete
